description: Irregular long-crested waves from a JONSWAP spectrum (Hs = 0.1 m, Tp = 1.5 s, gamma = 3.3, d = 1 m, 512 components with the equal-energy discretisation, fixed seed), FNPF: spectral significant wave height Hm0, peak period and spectral shape at x = 10, 15, 20 m against the target spectrum (band-averaged periodogram of 1024 s / 512 s of record).

reference.citation: Hasselmann et al. (1973) JONSWAP spectrum in the form of DNV-RP-C205 (2010) Sec. 3.5.5, A_gamma = 1 - 0.287 ln(gamma)
